approved_scope: Phase 2 study only; RF-F003 formal unchanged; Phase 3 remains paused.
description: RF-F003 with unchanged two IC variable-C branches and all existing passband/H2/H3 conditions, plus a mandatory >=20 dB external-port transducer-power attenuation across inclusive 3.000-6.000 GHz for each of the six settings.
validation_notes: No other RF-F003 override: two independent 0..3pF Q35 Cv branches, fixed input/output S2P, 50ohm source, 60-j40ohm load, 30dB mandatory H2/H3 on data/bands.csv and 35dB nominal target are inherited. New 3..6GHz attenuation requirement is checked at all 3001 points per setting on the frozen 1MHz S2P grid (including 3 and 6 GHz); finite-grid compliance does not establish continuous-frequency or physical robustness. Never mix with RF-T005 3-Cv trial. Requires allow_trial=True.
